chapters.title: He Doesn't Ask
chapters.synopsis: No one checks whether Ivo has eaten. The safety feels like a room with the furniture removed.

chapters.title: The Unfinished
chapters.synopsis: Partial people know the expedition's names because the Vein repeats patterns. They want the question finished so they can rest.

chapters.title: The Empty Side
chapters.synopsis: Ivo admits he misses being loved at close range. A flare goes up before he can cross the camp.

chapters.title: The Break
chapters.synopsis: Helix and a Vein-storm collapse the basin. The team splits. Radios die into a dead man's cadence.

chapters.title: Say It
chapters.synopsis: Ivo is missing. Calder searches until he finds him, and stays between Ivo and the stone long enough to break.

chapters.title: Don't You Dare
chapters.synopsis: The composure ends. Ivo says Calder's name like a person and will not leave him.

chapters.title: Day One
chapters.synopsis: Ivo keeps the vigil and reports the mission to an unconscious man. The team stops pretending this is only duty.

chapters.title: Day Three
chapters.synopsis: Believing Calder cannot hear, Ivo confesses the years he spent failing to forget him.

chapters.title: Won
chapters.synopsis: Calder has been awake. He waits until the truth is finished, then smiles and asks if he finally won.
